name: Clan Personalities
description: Living-world social sim: assigns personas (Peaceful, Neutral, Altruistic, Aggressive, Player-Killing) to living clans whose phantom members chatter, start drama and retaliate in chat, remembering what was said. This phase is chat-only: no combat behavior. v0.1.1 hardening: brain generations run on the pack's dedicated brain pool (never the game's timers), the boot probe no longer stalls server start, the warm-keeper sleeps with nobody online and stops with the module, persona files anchor to the pack's module registry root, and world-chat bystanders rotate instead of always asking the same townsperson.
author: Wyrbun
